Confidence score 2/5, citing forEach loops with async callbacks in packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts, packages/app-store/vital/lib/reschedule.ts, and packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings.tsx that can cause race conditions. The summary also says "12 files reviewed, no comments".
